description: TPL Insurance Limited is a Pakistani general insurer that positions itself as an insurtech, writing all lines of general insurance — motor, fire, marine, health, home, travel, mobile, cyber risk, engineering and agriculture — in both conventional and takaful form, backed by a 24/7 contact centre and digital distribution through partner businesses. It was the first insurer in the market to offer buy-now-pay-later auto insurance in instalments, and its reinsurance treaties are placed with international reinsurers including Hannover Re. PACRA assigns it an insurer financial strength rating of AA.
headOffice: Plot 19-B, Block B, Sindhi Muslim Co-operative Housing Society (SMCHS) 74900, Karachi, Pakistan
